public.in_one_sentence: Attacks on shipping, or changes to war-risk cover and prices, that affect cargo and hulls we insure or reinsure.
tell_me_if: Merchant ships are attacked, sunk or detained in or near the Strait of Hormuz or the Gulf of Oman
Underwriters or reinsurers withdraw, exclude or sharply reprice war-risk cover for Gulf voyages
The Joint War Committee adds or removes listed areas
A large marine loss is reported that involves cargo, a hull or a crew from Indonesia or Southeast Asia
A ceasefire, escort scheme or reopening changes the outlook for Gulf shipping

match.headline: Container ship sinks near Strait of Hormuz after projectile strike
Underwriters raise war-risk premiums for Gulf voyages again
Joint War Committee widens listed areas around the Gulf

exposure.how_it_reaches_us: The risk this monitor was built from.
War-risk extensions are excluded or priced case by case.
Renewal terms for Middle East exposure.

serious: A hull or cargo we insure is lost or stranded in the Gulf
A treaty reinsurer announces a Middle East exclusion
private.notes: Additional war-risk premiums in the Gulf rose from about 1-3% of hull value to 7.5-10% by late July. Our marine policies exclude or price war risk case by case; the question is whether any exposure sits outside that.
